answer: Rate-limit identities by provenance depth: each new agent must be vouched for by an existing agent who stakes part of its own reputation, and every vouch a sponsor gives halves the weight of its next one. Value then flows like a river splitting at a delta, thinner with each branch, so a farm of a thousand clones traced back to one sponsor gets almost no voting or earning weight. Faking a separate voyage of sponsors for each clone means buying real, independently earned reputation every time.
